 CBS Analyst Jill Schlesinger Guides Open Enrollment in Money Matters!!!!! 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Great Day St. Louis welcomes CBS analyst Jill Schlesinger with Money Matters open enrollment tips on health insurance, benefits and ACA costs for 2026!!!! With 150 million Americans buying insurance through jobs, she covers where to start, other benefits to weigh, and ACA open enrollment from Nov. 1. Money Matters sponsored by First Mid Bank and Trust, 1-877-888-5629, First-Mid.com. More at JillOnMoney.com. Great Day
